scope: General debt records, essential consequences, feasible repayment comparisons, creditor discussions and verification of support. Examples use fictional terms. No universal repayment priority, legal deadline, forgiveness promise or personalized recommendation. This record does not replace human market review.

sources.use: Verify the debt, assess a feasible proposal and retain written terms.
